AboutPage.paragraph1: I-Apostolos Missions International (AM) bubulungiseleli obudibanisa amabandla obuzinikele ekusasazeni iindaba ezilungileyo ukuya ezipheleni zomhlaba, singqina ngothando olungunaphakade lweNkosi.
AboutPage.paragraph2: (ἀπόστολος) ligama lesiGrike elithetha umpostile. Lithetha "lowo uthunyiweyo emsebenzini" okanye "umthunywa." Isibizo esithi "umpostile" sivela rhoqo kwiTestamente eNtsha simele abafundi abaLishumi elinesibini abamiselwa nguYesu (Mateyu 10:2, Marko 3:14, Luka 6:13, IZenzo 2:42). UPawulos, owayekhe watshutshisa ubuKrestu waza waba ngumvakalisi omkhulu weendaba ezilungileyo, wazazisa "njengompostile" (Roma 1:1, 1 Korinte 1:1, 2 Korinte 1:1, Galati 1:1, Kolose 1:1, 1 Timoti 1:1, 2 Timoti 1:1, Tito).
AboutPage.paragraph3: Abapostile ngabo bathunywe yiNkosi ukuze bazalisekise umsebenzi "wokushumayela uYesu Krestu nokwazisa uThixo" kwindalo yonke. Isiseko seBhayibhile sobupostile sifumaneka kumazwi amaninzi eNkosi eyakhetha abapostile bokuqala yaza yabathuma njengeenxusa ezithunyelwa ukumela amazwe ahlukeneyo. Abapostile babeqonda ukuba ubomi babo babungebobabo bodwa, kodwa babephilela ukutyhila uzuko lukaKrestu kweli hlabathi liwileyo.
AboutPage.blockquote: UYohane 20:21 uthi, "UYesu waphinda wathi kubo, 'Uxolo malube kuni! Njengokuba uBawo endithumile, nam ndiyanithuma.'" (NIV)
AboutPage.paragraph4: I-AM ifuna ukulandela isithethe sabapostile ababephila njengabantu abanomsebenzi wokuvakalisa iLizwi likaThixo. Ngamnye kuthi ukwafumana obu bizo bevela kuThixo bokuthunyelwa ehlabathini njengezandla neenyawo zaKhe. Sifuna ukunikela ubomi bethu ekulandeleni amanyathelo kaYesu nasekushumayeleni iindaba ezilungileyo kude kube sezipheleni zomhlaba.
AboutPage.paragraph5: Kanye njengokuba ubomi bethu buchukunyisiwe batshintshwa yiNkosi, sifuna ukutyhila uthando lweNkosi olwaboniswa kuthi, sibe sisibane kubo bonke abantwana baKhe abalahlekileyo nakubazalwana noodade bethu.

GetInvolvedHub.connectStep1Body: Zininzi iindlela zokuqhagamshelana ne-AM. Ungabhalisela iwebhusayithi yethu ephambili, www.amintl.org, ufumane iileta zeendaba. Okanye ungabhalisela iwebhusayithi yethu yesikolo seBhayibhile kwi-intanethi, www.amacademy.org, ufumane iindaba nezinkqubo zamva nje. Uvumelekile ukujonga umbono wethu, imisebenzi neenkqubo kumawebhusayithi ethu kwaye usithumelele i-imeyile nanini na ukuba unemibuzo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep2BodySuffix: apha ukuba ufuna ukuthetha nomnye wabasebenzi bethu ufumane ulucebiso kuhambo lwakho lokomoya. Ungenza idinga okanye uqhagamshelane nabasebenzi bethu. Uninzi lwabasebenzi bethu lunamava obomi basekhampasi kwaye luyaziqonda iimeko abafundi bezidingidi abajongana nazo. Baza kukunceda ufumane indlela efaneleke kakhulu kuhambo lwakho lokholo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodyPrefix: Ukuba ukulungele ukuqalisa inkqubo yethu yokufunda iBhayibhile,
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodySuffix: kweli phepha. Ukuba awuwufumani umhla okufaneleyo, ngenisa ifomu yesicelo nekhosi nexesha olithandayo!
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep4BodyPrefix: Ukuba ufuna ukuqhagamshelana neofisi yethu yesahluko sasekuhlaleni nabasebenzi bayo, nceda
GetInvolvedHub.growIntro: Kanye njengokuba sikhula size sivuthwe ngamanqanaba ahlukeneyo ebuntwaneni bethu, sifikelela kumanqanaba abalulekileyo ekukhuleni kwethu ngokomoya. I-AM inikezela ngeenkqubo neendlela ezininzi ezenzelwe ukukhokela abafundi kumanqanaba amathathu abalulekileyo okukhula ngokomoya:
GetInvolvedHub.rebornBody: Sizalwa ngokutsha ngedini locamagusho likaYesu emNqamlezweni.
GetInvolvedHub.matureBody: Sikhula size sivuthwe ngokomoya ngokondliwa luthando nenyaniso evela kuYesu.
GetInvolvedHub.fruitfulBody: Sifumana amava esiqhamo sobomi ngentsikelelo kaThixo, ezalisekisiweyo kumanyano lwethu oluvuthiweyo noKrestu Yesu.
GetInvolvedHub.navigatingBody: Ubomi basekhampasi buyachulumancisa buyanelisa, kodwa ngenxa yokhetho olungaka olukhoyo, bunokuvakala bungenanjongo. Ngenyaniso nangomthandazo, i-AM ikunceda ukuba uqonde intando kaThixo kwaye ufumane isikhokelo esicacileyo sobomi bakho obumangalisayo.
GetInvolvedHub.nextStepsBody: Qhubeka uthabathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zethu—sebenzisa amathuba ahlukeneyo okuva iLizwi, ukuthandaza kunye, ukuba nobudlelwane nabazalwana noodade bokholo, nokukhonza njengoko ukhula kwiindaba ezilungileyo.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep1Body: Njengokuba sikhula, sinqwenela ukukhonza abanye abafuna uncedo lokuza kuYesu. Njengoko sikhonza, nathi sikhula nzulu ngakumbi kuthando lukaKrestu.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep2Body: UYesu wathi, "Kunoyolo ngakumbi ukupha kunokwamkela" (IZenzo 20:35). Ukukhokela nokukhapha abanye kufuna ubulumko, umthandazo, idini, nomonde. Noko ke, yindawo esikelelweyo apho uzuko lomNqamlezo lufikelela encotsheni.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep3Body: Nangona abafundi bezidingidi besebatsha, izipho nezakhono ezibalaselayo zinokufunyanwa ziphuhliswe ngamandla ngakumbi kwiindima zobunkokeli. Yinkqubo entle njengokuba umfundi ngamnye evavanya eqinisekisa izipho zakhe zasezulwini ngamava obabalo okukhonza nokukhokela.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep4Body: I-AM inikezela ngamathuba neendima ezahlukeneyo zokuba abafundi bathabathe inxaxheba ekukhonzeni nakubunkokeli. Joyina iqela lethu labavolontiya, abasebenzi beSahluko, iinkokeli zeSahluko, ootitshala beBhayibhile, nabanye abaninzi. Fumanisa oko uYesu akutyaleyo kuwe ngokwecebo laKhe elibalaseleyo.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph1: Ukuphumelela edyunivesithi kukumka okunye okubalulekileyo okusinga kwihlabathi elivulekileyo ukuze siliphande. Abanye bethu basenokuqhubeka nemfundo okanye bathabathe indlela yomsebenzi. Abanye bethu bakwaba ngabasebenzi bexesha elipheleleyo be-AM, abathunywa bevangeli, okanye abefundisi belandela ubizo lukaThixo.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph2: Kweli nyathelo libalulekileyo, i-AM inikezela ngeenkqubo apho ungahlala uqhagamshelene uze uqhubeke ukhonza umsebenzi weendaba ezilungileyo nge-Alumni Connect. I-AM ikwanikezela ngeenkqubo zoqeqesho neendlela zokuba ngabasebenzi bomsebenzi wobuvangeli abanobuchule kwi-AM World Mission.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph3: Ukhetho oluhlukeneyo luvulekile kuwe ukusinga kwikamva eliqaqambileyo. I-AM inqwenela ukuhamba kufuphi nomntu ngamnye ukuze sizise bonke kunye kuMyalelo Omkhulu, "Ngoko ke hambani niye kwenza abafundi kuzo zonke iintlanga, nibabhaptiza egameni loYise neloNyana neloMoya oyiNgcwele (Mateyu 28:19)."

BibleStudyProgram.heading: Indlela yamanqanaba amahlanu ukusuka kumbuzo wokuqala ukuya ekuthunyweni.
BibleStudyProgram.description: Inkqubo ye-AM yokufunda iBhayibhile yamanqanaba amahlanu yinkqubo yokwenza abafundi nemfundo yeBhayibhile kwi-intanethi ekhokela abafundi kutyelelo olucwangcisiweyo lokufunda iindaba ezilungileyo zikaYesu Krestu nobomi bokholo. Le nkqubo idibanisa abafundi nootitshala beBhayibhile abaza kufundisa ngokwexesha lomphulaphuli. Iphelela kwithuba lokuvolontiya, ukuqeqeshelwa ukuba ngumthunywa wevangeli ongumfundi, okanye nje ukungena nzulu eLizwini likaThixo ne-AM.
